title: Pivot Valentine micro-app into “Find the NO Button” mini-game flow with levels, fake buttons, and replay ending

requirements.text: Replace the current screen flow in frontend/src/App.tsx with the new mini-game flow screens and navigation, using only client-side state transitions (no backend calls): (1) Game Intro, (2) Level 1, (3) Final Level, (4) Real Question, (5) YES Celebration, (6) Optional Extra-Cute Ending with Replay. The Replay action must restart the game from Game Intro (or Level 1) and reset any per-level counters/timers/messages.

quotes: 🎮💖 App Idea: “Find the NO Button (If You Can 😏)”

acceptanceCriteria: App no longer shows the old Build-up/Big Question/Sweet Ending flow by default; it follows the new mini-game progression.
All navigation is driven by button taps and internal state; no actor calls or React Query calls are required.
Tapping “Replay the game 😄” resets the game state (attempt counts, timers, fake buttons visibility) and returns to the first screen.

requirements.text:
Update the existing Intro screen UI to match the new Game Intro screen copy and primary action. User-facing text must be exactly:
- “Hi Anya 💕\nWelcome to a tiny game I made just for you.”
- “Your mission: find the NO button 😌”
Primary button label must be exactly: “🎮 Start Game”. Keep the screen mobile-first, centered, with a thumb-friendly bottom CTA area.

quotes:
“Hi Anya 💕
Welcome to a tiny game I made just for you.”

acceptanceCriteria: Intro screen displays the exact two text blocks and the exact “🎮 Start Game” button label.
Tapping “🎮 Start Game” advances to Level 1.
CTA remains large (>=56px height) and positioned in a bottom area suitable for one-handed use.

requirements.text: Implement Level 1 screen (“The Game Begins”) with the following exact user-facing header text at the top: “Level 1: Find the NO button ❌”. The screen must include animated distractions: hearts floating around, a teddy walking back and forth, and flowers popping in and out. Ensure animations are lightweight and mobile-optimized.

quotes:
Text at top:

“Level 1: Find the NO button ❌”

Hearts floating around

Teddy walking back and forth

Flowers popping in and out

acceptanceCriteria: Level 1 shows the exact header text at the top.
Hearts/teddy/flowers distraction animations are visible and do not block the primary interaction area.
Animations remain smooth on mobile and do not cause layout shift/jank.

requirements.text: Implement the Level 1 “hidden NO button” mechanic: a real NO button appears for approximately 0.5 seconds, then disappears, and repeatedly relocates to new positions. The NO button must sometimes appear visually ‘behind’ (partially occluded by) one of the distraction elements: a teddy, a flower, or a chocolate. When the user taps the area where the NO button last appeared, the NO button must immediately move/hide again and trigger a light vibration (using the browser Vibration API when available).

quotes: A NO button appears for half a second… then disappears

It hides behind:

A teddy 🧸

A flower 🌸

A chocolate 🍫
When she taps where it was, it moves again

acceptanceCriteria: The real NO button is only visible briefly (~0.5s) per appearance and is otherwise hidden.
The NO button relocates to new positions over time and/or after user interactions.
At least one of the hiding modes visually places the NO button partially behind a teddy/flower/chocolate asset (layering/occlusion).
Tapping the NO button’s last-known area causes it to relocate/hide again (even if the button is not currently visible).
On supported devices, a short vibration occurs when the NO button ‘escapes’.

requirements.text: Add Level 1 funny pop-up feedback messages that appear briefly after each miss/escape. Randomly select and display one of the following exact messages: “Nope 😜”, “Missed it!”, “It ran away!”, “Try again 😂”. After a few tries (define a consistent threshold, e.g., 4 misses), also show the exact progress line: “Hmm… this is harder than it looks 🤔”.

quotes:
Funny pop-ups:

“Nope 😜”

“Missed it!”

“It ran away!”

“Try again 😂”

After a few tries:

“Hmm… this is harder than it looks 🤔”

acceptanceCriteria: After each escape/miss event, one of the four funny pop-ups appears and auto-hides.
Pop-up messages match the exact spelling/punctuation/emoji provided.
After the configured number of tries, the progress line “Hmm… this is harder than it looks 🤔” appears at least once.

requirements.text: Implement the Final Level screen with the exact user-facing text: “Final Level: Last chance 😏”. The screen must show multiple fake tappable buttons with the exact labels: “NO?”, “Not this one”, “Almost!”. Each fake button must vanish when tapped. After the fake buttons sequence, the screen must clear and advance to the Real Question screen.

quotes:
Multiple fake buttons appear:

“NO?”
“Not this one”
“Almost!”

They all vanish when tapped.

Then the screen clears…

acceptanceCriteria: Final Level displays the exact header text.
At least three fake buttons appear with the exact labels and are tappable.
Tapping a fake button removes it from view (vanishes) with a lightweight animation.
After the fake buttons are gone (or after a short, deterministic sequence), the app transitions to the Real Question screen.

requirements.text:
Implement the Real Question screen with slowed-down pacing/feel and soft music behavior: keep the global AudioToggle, but on this screen emphasize the ‘soft music’ moment by presenting the content in a calmer animation cadence (e.g., slower fades). User-facing text must be exactly two lines:
- “Okay Anya… no more games.”
- “Will you be my Valentine? 💝”
Render one clear primary button labeled exactly: “✅ YES 💕”. Do not render any NO button on this screen.

quotes:
“Okay Anya… no more games.”
“Will you be my Valentine? 💝”

One clear button:

✅ YES 💕

(The NO button is nowhere 😌)

acceptanceCriteria: Real Question screen shows exactly the two lines of text and a single “✅ YES 💕” button.
No NO button is present in the DOM or visually on this screen.
Animations on this screen feel noticeably calmer/slower than Level 1/Final Level (e.g., longer fade durations).
AudioToggle remains available and continues to respect autoplay policies (music plays only after explicit user action).

requirements.text:
Update the YES celebration flow so that after tapping “✅ YES 💕” it (a) triggers confetti burst, (b) hearts explosion, (c) shows a teddy hugging a heart, then (d) displays the requested sweet messages one-by-one in order (each message visible clearly before the next appears):
1) “You are absolutely beautiful 🌸”
2) “I’m so grateful to have you in my life ❤️”
3) “Every moment with you means everything to me”
4) “Thank you for being you, Anya 🥰”
Then show the final line exactly:
“Happy Valentine’s Day 💕\nI’m really lucky to be with you.”

quotes:
🎉 When She Taps YES

✨ Confetti burst
💖 Hearts explode
🧸 Teddy hugs a heart

Sweet messages appear one by one:

“You are absolutely beautiful 🌸”
“I’m so grateful to have you in my life ❤️”
“Every moment with you means everything to me”
“Thank you for being you, Anya 🥰”

Final line:

“Happy Valentine’s Day 💕
I’m really lucky to be with you.”

acceptanceCriteria: Tapping “✅ YES 💕” triggers confetti + heart explosion style effects and a teddy-hugging-heart visual.
The four sweet messages appear sequentially in the exact order and text.
After the sequence, the final two-line message appears exactly as provided.
All celebration effects remain lightweight (no heavy video assets) and do not freeze on mobile.

requirements.text: Add the optional Extra-Cute Ending screen after the celebration sequence that shows a teddy holding a sign with the exact text: “Best Valentine Ever 🧸❤️” and a single button labeled exactly: “Replay the game 😄”.

quotes:
🥹 Optional Extra-Cute Ending

A final screen with:

Teddy holding a sign:

Button:
Replay the game 😄

acceptanceCriteria: After the celebration message sequence completes, the app navigates to the Extra-Cute Ending screen.
The ending screen includes a teddy + sign visual and the exact sign text.
The “Replay the game 😄” button is present and restarts the game flow per REQ-24.

requirements.text: Apply the requested mini-game visual style adjustments across the new game screens: pastel colors (pink, peach, lavender), soft bouncing animations, cute characters (teddy, hearts, flowers), and mobile-first one-hand-friendly layout (big tap areas, no zooming required).
acceptanceCriteria: New screens use a coherent pastel palette emphasizing pink/peach/lavender.
Tap targets for interactive elements meet mobile usability (>=44px, preferably >=56px for primary CTAs).
Layouts fit within viewport height on common mobile sizes without requiring pinch-zoom.

requirements.text: Incorporate the uploaded images into the app as static assets (stored under frontend/public/assets/generated or an equivalent static public path) and use them where appropriate for teddy/valentine-game visuals, ensuring any backgrounds that look like checkerboards are removed or avoided so assets appear clean on pastel backgrounds.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one uploaded teddy/heart illustration is visible in the UI on one or more game screens.
Assets used in-game do not show a checkerboard background; they render cleanly on the app background.
Static assets are served from the frontend (no backend image serving).

constraints: Frontend must not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not add backend dependencies; backend/main.mo should remain unchanged unless strictly necessary (this feature should be frontend-only).
Keep animations mobile-optimized and lightweight; cap particle counts and avoid heavy video-like assets.
All user-facing text included in these changes must be in English and match the exact strings provided in the user request where specified.
Music playback must continue to respect browser autoplay policies (requires explicit user action via the existing audio control).
nonGoals: Adding user accounts, persistence, leaderboards, or any backend data storage for game progress.
Integrating third-party auth beyond Internet Identity (not needed for this mini-game).
Implementing external audio streaming; only local/static audio behavior is in scope.
